heading: Sanctions exception relating to importation of goods

tree.heading: In general
tree.text: The authorities and requirements to impose sanctions under this chapter shall not include the authority or requirement to impose sanctions on the importation of goods.

tree.heading: Good defined
tree.text: In this section, the term “good” means any article, natural or man-made substance, material, supply, or manufactured product, including inspection and test equipment, and excluding technical data.
